newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: M-NET BOOSTS HALF-YEAR EARNINGS.
newsitem.headline: M-NET BOOSTS HALF-YEAR EARNINGS.

text.p: Half year ended September 30
(million rand unless stated)
Shr 8.9 cts vs 7.4 cts
Div - -
Attrib profit 24.9 vs 20.8
Pre-tax 38.6 vs 33.0
Finance income 2.1 vs 0.9
Turnover 391.2 vs 311.9
Full name: Electronic Media Network Ltd
NOTE - The subscription television operator said its policy
was to declare and pays a single dividend each year.
The directors said new competitors which plan to come on
stream in South Africa in coming months were likely to have a
negative impact on M-Net's suscriber numbers and advertising
revenue. Elsewhere in Africa opportunities for expansion were
being pursued and initial indications were positive.
The company said it was also exposed to increasing costs
arising from the declining value of the rand currency.
-- Johannesburg newsroom -27-11-482.1003
